description: A notice under Article 16 of the Digital Services Act that content on fordeal.ai is illegal (a user review, product information, an offer, an image or anything else). Give `content_kind` review | product_info | offer | image | other, the `page_url` of the content (and the `product_slug` when it is on a product page), an `explanation` of why the content is illegal (20–4000 characters), the notifier's `name` and `email`, and `good_faith: true` confirming the notice is accurate and complete to the best of the notifier's knowledge. A person reviews every notice; the e-mail gets a confirmation of receipt at once and the decision later. For a wrong price or variant use report_issue instead. Public, no key; the anonymous rate limit applies.

content_kind.description: What content the notice is about.

email.description: The notifier's e-mail: the confirmation of receipt and the decision go there.

good_faith.description: Confirms the bona fide belief that the information is accurate and complete (Art. 16(2)(d)).

ip_hash.description: sha-256 of the notifier's address with a daily salt (the website computes it); counts the per-visitor limit.

page_url.description: The exact page of the content (Art. 16(2)(b)).

product_slug.description: Product slug when the content is on a product page.

name: report_illegal_content
title: Report illegal content (DSA Art. 16)
